ModMetaData.name: Fabricors can repair mechs
ModMetaData.author: Witek
ModMetaData.description:
Allows Fabricors to repair mechs.
- Fabricors repair colony mechs that have auto-repair enabled. - A Fabricor never repairs itself. - A Fabricor never repairs a mech that is currently repairing something. - A damaged Fabricor does not repair other Fabricors (no back-and-forth repairs).
Requires Biotech and Harmony.
https://github.com/witks/RimWorld-FabricorsCanRepairMechs
